t1.text: D21 map feel: desktop (Earn mode, dark)

s1.text:
From your 8 Nov video:

1. Scroll wheel, trackpad pinch and double-click zoom the MAP (today they zoom the whole browser page).
2. Zoom is smooth; the old map stays on screen while the new one loads, so it never goes blank.
3. The map stays on India; you cannot drift to America.
4. Results refresh by themselves when you stop moving. "Search this area" and the top km bar are gone.
5. + and − stay as two small buttons at the bottom right (for people without a mouse wheel), like Google Maps.
6. The panel: one big hero card, everything fits, no scroll bar.

All names, prices and areas are sample data.

s2.text:
List view changes:

1. The empty grey "Jobs near you" box is gone. With an area: a short live map strip. Without one: a one-line "Set your area" card.
2. One List/Map switch (today there are two Map buttons).
3. Cards: same height, title in 2 lines, at most 2 tags, price and Apply on one line.
4. Filter chips slide sideways with no scroll bar.

Every filter, tab and category stays.

s3.text:
Phone browser: pinch to zoom the map, two fingers never zoom the page. The Android app already uses Google Maps and keeps it; only the Expo Go fallback changes.

The sheet grows by dragging its handle; inside it the list scrolls with no bar.
